headline: Former PM Ishiba: Consumption Tax Cut Would Damage Public Finances and Push Up Prices – Mainichi Forum
summary: Former Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba said he is definitely not in favour of a two-year consumption tax cut on food and beverages. He warned it would damage public finances and push up prices.
why: Japan's consumption tax funds a large share of government revenue, so changes to the rate affect fiscal policy, government bond demand and consumer prices.
